profilePeriod: Premiership 2007–2010 and 2013; 2006 conscience speeches and explicitly dated later positions through September 2026.
scopeNote: Answers are editorial simulations of documented political principles, not a questionnaire completed by the person. Brazil-specific statements are interpreted in the analogous home-country context. Modern hypothetical technologies require inference.

sources.title: Kevin Rudd: during office
sources.evidence: National Archives documents Kyoto ratification, Indigenous apology, crisis response, Fair Work legislation and public participation initiatives.

sources.title: A National Health and Hospitals Network
sources.evidence: National funding and standards combined with locally run hospital networks; proposed referendum if states refused reforms.

sources.title: Rudd wins Caucus support for party reform
sources.evidence: Party members gained half the leadership ballot weight alongside caucus; heightened thresholds also protected the incumbent leader.

sources.title: The global financial crisis
sources.evidence: Rudd argues for social democratic regulation and public action to preserve a functioning market economy, rejecting neoliberal minimal government.

sources.title: National Press Club Address: The Complacent Country
sources.evidence: Supports AUKUS, US alliance, sovereign naval capability and further defence spending while expanding dialogue with China. Advocates seven sector industry plans, domestic car production and retaining Austal in Australian hands; seeks private venture capital, investment, macroeconomic discipline and post-crisis fiscal repair. AI development includes personal data opt-outs and energy safeguards; elected governments set priorities.

sources.title: The Significance of AI in US-China Strategic Competition
sources.evidence: Discusses AI as a strategic technological opportunity and risk in US-China competition; latest dated technology speech reviewed.

sources.title: Ethnic Business Awards address
sources.evidence: Celebrates immigration, ethnic enterprise and multiculturalism as an Australian way of life.

sources.title: Australia and Papua New Guinea Regional Settlement Arrangement
sources.evidence: Boat arrivals without visas denied Australian settlement; PNG processing and settlement. Retains humanitarian program and possibility of expanding orderly intake.

sources.title: Largest Australian free trade agreement to begin in 2010
sources.evidence: Announces ASEAN-Australia-New Zealand agreement eliminating tariffs on most Australian exports to ASEAN.

sources.title: Faith in Politics
sources.evidence: Christian faith motivates social justice, protection of vulnerable people and internationalism. Rejects reducing Christian politics to sexual morality or partisan allegiance.

sources.title: Church and State are able to have different positions on same-sex marriage
sources.evidence: Reverses prior opposition to civil same-sex marriage; supports secular marriage equality and children in loving same-sex families, with religious institutions exempt from performing such ceremonies.

sources.title: RU486 conscience speech
sources.evidence: Conservative sanctity-of-life views and desire to reduce abortions coexist with supporting expert TGA regulation of RU486, sex education, contraception and family support. Explicitly acknowledges state jurisdiction and reason alongside faith.

sources.title: Australian Parliament lifts ban on therapeutic cloning
sources.evidence: Associated Press reports Rudd opposing creating human embryos solely for experimentation; does not establish opposition to all biotechnology.

sources.title: Rudd says no apologies for internet filter
sources.evidence: Reports Rudd personally defending mandatory internet filtering as child protection; policy support rather than completed implementation.

sources.title: Interview on death penalty policy
sources.evidence: States opposition to death penalty while distinguishing diplomatic intervention for Australians and foreign citizens.

sources.title: Australian Prime Minister Explains Why He Opposes Euthanasia
sources.evidence: Reports personal opposition to euthanasia while allowing parliamentary conscience votes. Advocacy outlet; corroborating 2009 South Australian Hansard quotes opposition, so treated cautiously.

sources.title: Address to United Nations General Assembly
sources.evidence: Advocates cooperation, multilateral institutions and combining national interests with international interests.

sources.title: The Avoidable War — publisher record
sources.evidence: PublicAffairs publisher identifies Kevin Rudd as author and first publication 22 March 2022. Political argument for managed strategic competition to avoid US-China war.

sources.title: A China de Xi Jinping — Brazilian catalogue
sources.evidence: Author biography calls another work A guerra evitável but supplies no edition record for it. This alone does not verify a Brazilian translation of The Avoidable War.

facts: 2010 reform centralised funding and standards while retaining local hospital delivery.
2006 RU486 speech recognised constitutional state responsibilities.
estrutura.tension: National coordination and equal provision do not mean abolishing states, municipalities or all local discretion.

facts: 2013 reform widened party-member leadership voting.
2026 speech assigns elected government policy authority and public servants implementation.
representacao.tension: Leadership stabilisation and expert administration coexist with elections, parliamentary opposition and accountability; not assembly anarchism or expert rule without votes.

facts: Defended internet filtering in 2010.
Opposed death penalty and personally opposed euthanasia.
2026 advocated enforceable AI personal-data protections.
poder.tension: Protective regulation and policing coexist with judicial rights and data privacy; filtering is not proof of support for unlimited censorship or indefinite imprisonment.

facts: Praised multiculturalism and immigrant enterprise in 2008.
2013 PNG arrangement excluded unauthorised boat arrivals from settlement while maintaining humanitarian intake.
imigracao.tension: Strict border enforcement is not ethnic assimilation or rejection of plural cultures; civic integration is distinct from surrendering ancestral traditions.

facts: 2026 endorsed AUKUS, naval capacity and higher defence spending.
UN speech and 2022 book promote diplomacy to avoid catastrophic war.
diplomacia.tension: Armed deterrence and allied security, but not preventive wars for prestige, nuclear proliferation or absolute pacifism.

facts: UN cooperation and international law are central.
2026 calls for stronger regional defence partnerships and national resilience.
intervencao.tension: Active alliance diplomacy and regional influence coexist with constraints on unilateral domination; not blanket neutrality or withdrawal from peacekeeping.

facts: Public crisis intervention, Fair Work and national health funding.
2026 industry policy explicitly partners with private companies and venture capital.
economia.tension: Regulated capitalism and public essential services, neither collective ownership of all production nor privatisation of all services.

facts: 2009 case for social democratic financial oversight.
2026 seven sector industry plans, renewable finance, Keynesian countercyclical spending and subsequent fiscal repair.
controle.tension: Strategic state coordination does not entail a command economy, permanent deficits or abolishing independent market price signals.

facts: 2009 ASEAN agreement expands free trade and tariff reduction.
2026 wants domestic auto and critical supply capabilities and Australian ownership of Austal.
comercio.tension: Integration with targeted resilience and ownership safeguards; neither economic autarky nor unconditional free trade regardless of strategic consequences.

facts: 2006 Christian social-gospel political argument.
2013 explicit secular civil marriage alongside religious freedom.
religiao.tension: Personal faith and religious public voices without theocracy, official majority religious law or denying nonbelievers moral capacity.

facts: 2013 accepts marriage equality and same-sex parenting evidence.
2006 morally conservative abortion language alongside sex education, contraception and RU486 access.
moral.tension: Later equal civil rights should not be erased by early conservatism, nor should religious family/bioethical reservations disappear into unrestricted lifestyle libertarianism.

facts: 2026 embraces AI, biotechnology, industrial innovation and renewable energy.
2006 opposed creating embryos for research.
Kyoto and climate response prioritised.
tecnologia.tension: Technology for growth and climate action with biological ethics and privacy safeguards; neither primitivism nor unconstrained enhancement.

uncertainties: Public record does not answer every modern hypothetical: facial recognition, crypto, enhancement, polyamory and Brazilian quotas require bounded interpretation, not invented quotations.
Brazil-specific institutions and regions are interpreted by political principle in Australian context.
No verified later reversal of 2006 embryo ethics or 2008 euthanasia stance was found; these are explicitly dated, not asserted as freshly restated in 2026.
Searches through 2026-10-01 checked recent AUKUS, AI and industry speeches; profile period remains the original explicit scope.

No Brazilian edition of The Avoidable War was verified after original title, Portuguese title, ISBN and Brazilian retail searches; translated biography mention alone insufficient. Original title retained.
